sentences.text: Seth Aaron Rogen -LRB- -LSB- ˈroʊɡən -RSB- born April 15 , 1982 -RRB- is a Canadian-American actor , filmmaker , and comedian .
He began his career performing stand-up comedy during his teenage years , winning the Vancouver Amateur Comedy Contest in 1998 .	Vancouver	Vancouver	stand-up comedy	stand-up comedy
While still living in his native Vancouver , he landed a supporting role in the series Freaks and Geeks .	Vancouver	Vancouver	Freaks and Geeks	Freaks and Geeks
Shortly after he moved to Portland , Oregon for his role , Freaks and Geeks was officially cancelled after one season due to low viewership .	Freaks and Geeks	Freaks and Geeks
Rogen later got a part on sitcom Undeclared , which also hired him as a staff writer .	sitcom	sitcom	Undeclared	Undeclared

After landing his job as a staff writer on the final season of Da Ali G Show , for which he and the other writers received an Emmy Award nomination , he was guided by Judd Apatow toward a film career .	Da Ali G Show	Da Ali G Show	Emmy Award	Emmy Award	Judd Apatow	Judd Apatow
Rogen made his first movie appearance in Donnie Darko with a minor role as a rebellious student in Donnie 's high school classes in 2001 .	Donnie Darko	Donnie Darko
Rogen was cast in a major supporting role and credited as a co-producer in Apatow 's directorial debut , The 40-Year-Old Virgin .	The 40-Year-Old Virgin	The 40-Year-Old Virgin

After Rogen received critical praise for his performance , Universal Pictures agreed to cast him as the lead in Apatow 's films Knocked Up and Funny People .	Universal Pictures	Universal Pictures	Knocked Up	Knocked Up	Funny People	Funny People
Rogen co-starred as Steve Wozniak in Universal 's Steve Jobs biopic in 2015 .	Steve Wozniak	Steve Wozniak	Steve Jobs	Steve Jobs (film)
In 2016 , he developed the AMC television series Preacher with his writing partner Evan Goldberg and Sam Catlin .	Preacher	Preacher (TV series)	Evan Goldberg	Evan Goldberg	Sam Catlin	Sam Catlin
He also serves as a writer and executive producer , and directed the first two episodes of the series with Goldberg .

Rogen and Goldberg co-wrote the films Superbad , Pineapple Express , The Green Hornet , This Is the End , and directed both This Is the End and The Interview ; all of which Rogen starred in .
